note: The Six Lines demo walkthrough in Simplified Chinese (the English is walkthrough.json): music and burned-in text, no voice. The plan is series/critic/demo/review-2.md (changed timeline, 8/10). Rendered by `node scripts/demo.mjs`. Beats are at the music's tempo. A live shot plays a take under public/ from `from` seconds at `rate`; `zoom` and `focus` (0 top, 1 bottom) crop into the phone screen, and `place` puts the text at the top or bottom.

from.how: mobile-mcp screen recording; variable frame rate, converted with ffmpeg -vf fps=30,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 for Remotion to seek it by time

take14.recorded: 2026-09-26, iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator (iOS 26.2), sixlines-ios PR #196 (merged b23cd1ea: Classical text follows the chosen script, so a Simplified UI no longer shows Traditional characters), Matrix skin, Gua on 8bitoracle-next 9fbb652 (PR #286), Simplified Chinese (-appLanguage zh-Hans). Question typed with 可是 in place of 但, so the app did not return a saved reading; 18 entered by hand with no changing lines; one fresh Gua interpretation. A reminder prompt after the reading was dismissed. Supersedes takes 8 and 9, which were recorded before the Simplified fix (Wang Bi was in Traditional).

shots.text:
我要接手爸妈的店，
可是生意越来越差。
该从哪里改起？

texts.text:
不是简单
回答是否。

让你理解及
想清楚事情。

发现腐败之处，
就要清除。

shots.text:
解读这一卦，
明白你的店
所在处境。

王弼的注，
写于三世纪。

解读也写明：
怎样算它错了。

你来决定。
然后记下结果。
